description:
The UC Latino Physician Consortium is currently accepting poster abstract submissions for their 2nd Annual Summit hosted at the UCR School of Medicine on Friday, October 2, 2026. 

This summit will welcome University of California physicians/physician alumni, medical students, and residents/fellows for a day of learning and development, including a research symposium! Projects led by a UC faculty member and that impact Latino health are welcome to apply by scanning the QR code and submitting an abstract by 9/1. 

Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis.
title: UC Latino Physician Consortium 2nd Annual Summit

description:
Are you planning on joining us for the UC Latino Physician Consortium on October 2 & 3, 2026, at the UCR School of Medicine? It's open to any UC medical students, residents, fellows, physicians, and physician alumni. Event information and registration can be found via the QR code on the image or by visiting https://myadv.ucr.edu/forms/UCLPC

If you need a room, there are just a few days remaining to reserve your room at the Mission Inn Hotel and Spa. Use the link in our Linktree to get the discounted rate.
title: UC Latino Physician Consortium Summit

description:
Some research doesn’t stay inside the lab.

At the CE-CERT Open House on October 6, get an up-close look at UCR’s Mobile Isotope Laboratory, a research lab on wheels used to measure greenhouse gases in real time and help researchers understand where emissions are coming from.

And that’s just one stop. Visitors will tour CE-CERT research facilities, meet the students behind the work, and connect with 12+ campus, industry, and community organizations at our Open House Resource Fair.

Choose a morning or afternoon session and come explore CE-CERT.

📅 October 6, 2026
📍 CE-CERT | UC Riverside
Free and open to the public

Register at the link in our bio.

#UCR #UCRiverside #CECERT #UCREngineering #OpenHouse #STEM #Riverside
host: UCR CE-CERT | Center for Environmental Research and Technology
title: CE-CERT Open House: Morning Session

description:
Curious about the future of clean energy and sustainable technology?

#UCRiverside #CECERT #EnvironmentalScience #CleanTech #STEM #OpenHouse #RiversideCA #Sustainability @ucrcecert @ucrbcoe
